url.description: Direct Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint (HTTP(S) with host, not legacy /sse); exclusive with configPath/server. No embedded credentials or configured auth headers. Private/loopback hosts allowed, redirects disabled; trust the endpoint. HTTP subscribe is unsupported; configured HTTP targets have the same limitation.

configPath.description: Existing MCP JSON configuration path, absolute or relative to host project cwd; requires server for every resource action, including list. Use trusted configuration: connecting can launch its command or send its configured HTTP headers.

server.description: Exact enabled mcpServers key; required with configPath, forbidden with url. subscribe requires a configured stdio server (not a configured HTTP server).

action.description: Defaults to list (aggregates resources, not resource templates). read/subscribe/unsubscribe require uri. subscribe registers stdio notifications; no initial read, updates arrive at TurnEnd. Repeat subscribe starts a new local lifetime and drops old queued updates. unsubscribe stops local delivery/purges queued content even if remote cleanup fails; returned unsubscribed=true is not a remote acknowledgement.

uri.description: Exact server resource URI, required for read/subscribe/unsubscribe; ignored by list. Opaque string forwarded verbatim, not a local filesystem path and not locally URI-validated. Prefer a URI returned by list; the server determines access and existence.

timeoutSeconds.description: Per-request deadline in seconds, 1-300; omission uses configured timeout clamped to 1-300 (configuration default 60), or 60 for direct url. Not the subscription lifetime or a guarantee of update delivery. Each handshake/list/read/registration request has its own deadline.
